definitions: A character from the video game Dark Souls, known for his iconic phrase 'Praise the Sun!' and his unwavering optimism.
Often used informally to refer to someone who is exceptionally optimistic, friendly, or helpful, especially in challenging situations, reminiscent of the character.
examples: Many players consider Solaire to be one of the most beloved NPCs in gaming.
He's such a Solaire, always looking on the bright side even when things are tough.
I need a Solaire in my life to help me through this project.
